description: A woman with her hair pinned up, in a cream blouse and dark bodice, leans over a wooden table in a dim room lit by two candles. She is spreading a large flag on the table: a dark blue canton with a ring of white stars, and red and white stripes running across the rest. Spools of thread, a sewing kit and a window glow are visible in the background. No visible text, frame or border.
